Kuvitus: kaksi samanlaista vaakaa, joide: Illustration: two identical scales showing the same reading. On the left scale a petrol can, on the right firewood. Beside each, the same substance burns in a fire bowl: the petrol's flame is clearly larger than the wood's.
Periaatekuva, ei mittakaavassa: kasa pol: Schematic illustration, not to scale: a pile of firewood contains chemical energy. When it burns, the wood turns into a flame in which the chemical energy is released as heat and light. The energy released is found by multiplying the mass of the fuel by the heat of combustion.
Vaakapylväskaavio polttoaineiden lämpöar: Horizontal bar chart of the heats of combustion of fuels in MJ/kg, rounded values: natural gas 48, petrol 43, diesel 43, coal 26, wood pellets 17, firewood (air-dried) 15 and peat 10. The bar lengths are to scale: the natural gas bar is about five times as long as the peat bar.
Periaatekuva ravintoarvomerkinnästä, esi: Schematic illustration of a nutrition label, an example and not a real product: the package says energy 2200 kJ per hundred grams. When the energy is converted to megajoules and the mass to kilograms, you get the energy content of the food, 22 MJ/kg.
